name: omp-jev-router
description: Routes OMP orchestration activation and generic TASK model tier with TypeSafe Jev typed decisions.

jevModel.description: TypeSafe model id; empty uses the SDK default (jev-latest).

orchestrationRoutingEnabled.description: Decide per user request whether to activate OMP's native orchestrate contract.

orchestrationMinConfidence.description: max(probabilities) an orchestration decision must reach.

orchestrationMinMargin.description: top1 - top2 an orchestration decision must reach.

taskRoutingEnabled.description: Pick @task vs @task_hard for generic task spawns.

taskMinConfidence.description: max(probabilities) a tier decision must reach; below it the spawn goes deep.

taskMinMargin.description: top1 - top2 a tier decision must reach; below it the spawn goes deep.

normalTaskRole.description: Model role for TASK_NORMAL. 'task' leaves OMP's bundled agent untouched.

routingTimeoutMs.description: Hard per-decision budget; expiry falls back instead of retrying.

maxRoutingInputChars.description: Upper bound on the text sent to Jev per decision.

telemetryEnabled.description: Aggregate local route counts and worker cost. No prompt text is stored.

debugLogging.description: Emit one metrics-only line per routing decision to the OMP log.

scripts.build: bun run gen:agents && bun run check && bun run lint && bun test
scripts.format: oxfmt src scripts test package.json tsconfig.json
